summary: Aegon Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Jennifer Palmieri as Chief Human Resources Officer effective June 29, 2026, succeeding Holly Waters who will retire June 1, 2026. This is a routine management succession, not abrupt or forced. No stake, price, premium, or deal terms are involved. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under the 1934 Act. The change is part of the company's ongoing transition of its head office to the US. There are no special situation mechanics or risk-arb angle to note. Given the routine nature, this is classified as a low-confidence Management Change.
